title: Rollout forensics & auto-rollback explorer for Console
creator: Mariana Torres
description:
Goal: Build a Console explorer focused on rollout forensics and automated rollback signals. This view will help PMs, SREs, and ML engineers quickly diagnose degradation from canaries, A/B cohorts, or shadow traffic and either trigger or suggest auto-rollback actions. The explorer will combine per-route metric diffs, request traces anchored to anomalous users/requests, and a lightweight experiment metadata panel (model version, traffic split, rollout policy).

Key problems to solve:
- Fast triage: show which routes and cohorts diverged in the last N minutes and why (latency, error rate, hallucination regressions, quality metric drops).
- Trace linking: from cohort diff to representative traces that surface model outputs + token-level latency.
- Auto-rollback: define safe, auditable rollback triggers with one-click confirm and an option for automated rollbacks with audit trail.
- Cross-environment parity: same UX for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments (permissions respected).

Scope: Build Console UX, backend query endpoints, and lightweight evaluation hooks that kick off the rollback pipeline. Integrations: Observability metrics (Prometheus/Telemetry), tracing (OpenTelemetry), evaluation harness (redwood-evals), and Rollout orchestration (ENG rollout service).
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with ENG and Design. Agreed minimal signals: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, generation perplexity delta from eval set, and user-reported failure rate.
2026-03-04: Design prototypes completed (DES-231). Primary view shows cohort diff heatmap + top 3 divergent routes. Feedback: include quick-replay of sample responses inline.
2026-03-08: Backend contract drafted. ENG to expose /rollout/forensics API returning cohort diffs, top N traces, and model metadata. ENG-8421 assigned for API and telemetry schema.
2026-03-11: Security review flagged audit-log retention for automated rollbacks. Decided to require explicit admin opt-in for auto-rollback in Private deployments.
2026-03-13: Spike results: response sampling at 1% provides stable diffs for P50/P95 and cost under budget in staging.
acceptance_criteria: Console explorer surfaces cohort diff heatmap for a selected rollout with p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and quality metric percent delta.
From any diff cell user can open 3 representative traces with model inputs/outputs and per-token latencies.
One-click rollback button that opens confirm modal, logs action to audit trail, and triggers ENG rollout service rollback endpoint.
Auto-rollback policy editor in Console that allows threshold rules, cooldown, and scoped to routes or cohorts. Policies persist and apply at rollout creation.
Behavior parity validated in Dedicated staging environment and Private VPC with SSO permissions respected.
notes: Trade-offs: storing full traces for all requests is expensive; we will sample traces and store lightweight fingerprints for quick correlation. Full trace replay accessible for retained samples only.
Decision: quality regressions use 'eval-set delta' as default signal. For custom models customers may upload their own eval set to the rollout to get per-cohort quality diffs.
Risk: auto-rollback in Private deployments requires explicit admin consent due to compliance concerns. We'll add an enterprise toggle and logging responsibility matrix.
Follow-ups: add automated root-cause suggestions (e.g., quantization mismatch, increased KV cache miss rate) in subsequent cycles once trace-enrichment is available.
